initiatives.name: Blackbird Infoshop
initiatives.description: Anarchist infoshop and social center in Kingston, NY, with a lending library and free store. Its café closed to walk-ins in Dec 2025, and it now opens for events and by appointment.

initiatives.name: Kingston Emergency Food
initiatives.description: Coalition of groups and volunteers in Kingston, NY delivering prepared meals to people in motels and weekly groceries to households, with a 24-hour food hotline.
